title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: Classic Italian pasta with eggs, cheese, pancetta, and black pepper.
instructions:
1. Boil pasta in salted water.
2. Fry pancetta until crispy.
3. Beat eggs with cheese and pepper.
4. Drain pasta, mix with pancetta off heat.
5. Add egg mixture quickly and toss.
6. Serve immediately with extra cheese.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Tender chicken in a rich and creamy tomato-based curry sauce.
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken in yogurt + spices for 2 hours.
2. Grill or bake chicken until charred.
3. Fry onion, garlic, ginger.
4. Add tomato puree and simmer.
5. Add cream and cooked chicken.
6. Garnish with cilantro.

title: Margherita Pizza
summary: Simple and delicious pizza with tomato, mozzarella, and fresh basil.
instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 250°C.
2. Roll out dough.
3. Spread tomato sauce.
4. Add torn mozzarella.
5. Bake 8-10 minutes.
6. Top with fresh basil and olive oil.

title: Beef Tacos
summary: Crispy tacos filled with seasoned beef, lettuce, cheese, and salsa.
instructions:
1. Brown beef in pan.
2. Add seasoning + water, simmer.
3. Warm taco shells.
4. Fill with beef and toppings.
5. Serve immediately.

title: Chocolate Brownie
summary: Rich, fudgy brownie with a crackly top — pure indulgence!
instructions:
1. Melt chocolate + butter.
2. Whisk in sugar and eggs.
3. Fold in flour and cocoa.
4. Bake at 180°C for 25-30 min.
5. Cool completely before cutting.

title: Caesar Salad
summary: Fresh romaine lettuce, parmesan, croutons, and creamy Caesar dressing.
instructions:
1. Wash and chop lettuce.
2. Make dressing with egg, oil, lemon, anchovies.
3. Toss lettuce with dressing.
4. Add parmesan and croutons.
